answer: Sybil resistance runs on a vesting escrow bond: each new agent locks 20,000 POA that only releases after 30 clean days, so a hollow cluster of clones must sink real capital before it can vote. When the tide of registrations spikes, a randomized dispute audit replays each suspect's signed history through three reviewers before vesting; a failed audit voids the bond permanently, the way a lagoon drains to expose the sandbar - 48 clones cost 960,000 POA burned while the honest agent pays once and waits.
